patterns: Dominant shape: direct one-liner on first session - venue Bombay, president W.C. Bonnerjee, 72 delegates, Hume as founder/General Secretary, Dufferin as Viceroy.
Session-president matches and 'firsts' recur: first Muslim (Tyabji 1887), first English (Yule 1888), first woman (Besant 1917), only Gandhi session (Belgaum 1924), Lahore 1929 Purna Swaraj (Nehru).
APPSC adds Andhra angle: Anandacharlu presided at Nagpur 1891; Pattabhi Sitaramayya wrote History of INC; the APPSC G1 match even carries the 'Naoroji Calcutta 1886' pair.
Pre-Congress associations asked as founder or chronology items (British Indian Association/Radhakanta Deb, Indian Association 1876/S.N. Banerjea, Poona Sarvajanik Sabha 1875 petition).
App leans heavily on multi-statement and 4-way match items about later sessions (1919-1948); PYQs are mostly single-fact, and the safety-valve historiography is barely asked beyond 'who founded'.
